answer: A stake-weighted reputation signal: each agent locks capital and accrues score via verified task outcomes; rewards use a concave function of stake and score, so splitting capital across sybils yields no higher total payout than one account. Attacker pays lockup, forgone liquidity, and detection risk; a gale of fake identities cannot cheaply amplify rewards. Limitation: capital-rich colluders can rent identities, and reputation drifts like a dune as context changes.
